from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancingCashFlowRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of net cash flow from financing activities extracted from a single document."""
    company: str = Field(description="The company name as written in the document")
    fiscal_year: str = Field(description="The fiscal year for which the financial data applies (e.g., '2022', '2023')")
    report_fiscal_year: str = Field(description="The fiscal year of the financial report filing itself (e.g., '2022')")
    metric_label: str = Field(description="The line-item text describing the cash flow (e.g., 'net cash provided by financing activities')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported monetary amount; None if not found or unparseable")
    unit: str = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financing_cash_flow_records: list[FinancingCashFlowRecord] = Field(description="All financing cash flow records found in the current document")
